user.title: Connect to IR/RF Hub
user.description: Open the IR/RF Hub App: the first time it starts, it shows a pairing code on a screen you can't dismiss until you pair.

hassio_confirm.title: IR/RF Hub
hassio_confirm.description: Home Assistant found the IR/RF Hub App running and confirmed it's reachable. Submit to finish connecting: no code to copy.

error.invalid_code: That doesn't look like a valid pairing code. Open the App again to see the current one.
error.invalid_auth: The App rejected this pairing code. It may have been regenerated: copy a fresh one.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the App. Make sure it's running and try again.

abort.invalid_auth: The App rejected the pairing token it announced. It may have been regenerated: open the App to get a fresh one and add the integration manually.
abort.cannot_connect: Found the App but couldn't reach it. Make sure it's running and try again.

init.title: IR/RF Hub
init.description: Choose how commands should be grouped into devices.

auth_failed.title: {title} rejected the pairing token
auth_failed.description: The App's saved pairing token no longer works: most likely it was reinstalled and issued a fresh one. Commands have stopped updating. Open the App to see its current pairing code, then go to Settings → Devices & services → {title} and reconfigure with it. This clears on its own once a resync succeeds again.
